name: Phototriac optocoupler
summary: An optical isolation device whose output is a light-triggered triac-type switching element.
description: An optical isolation device whose output is a light-triggered triac-type switching element.

On a schematic, identify the LED input, output main terminals and any zero-cross feature and trace the external AC switching or triggering circuit. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
A phototriac driver is not necessarily the load-carrying power TRIAC; zero-cross and random-phase variants need the selected manual.

The preview is an independently drawn educational functional reference. Add the selected component’s actual power pins, terminal numbers, timing or analogue reference details when producing a construction drawing.
